cross-reference.answer: Read §2002:8.13 whole: the same thirteen information items as §2023:8.13, ending 'any other information that the implementor requires', the same signature definition and the same two mechanism sentences (update; flag differences). 2002 adds an opening sentence naming the source units the repository holds and points at 12.2.7 where 2023 points at 12.3.8; neither changes the two mechanisms this item documents. The mechanisms are edition-independent CLI options, shown at --std 2002 in probe-repository-2002.log (COBOL5969 with check on; COBOL5968 with update off).
